2607.14328.title: ViPSAM: Visual Prompting Medical Image Segmentation Using Segment Anything Model
2607.14328.paper_summary: In proton therapy planning, respiratory-gated non-contrast CT (NCCT) is commonly used for lesion segmentation; however, accurate delineation remains challenging due to low lesion-to-background contrast. Although learning-based methods have shown strong performance, they often struggle with non-contrast image segmentation. Inspired by clinical practice, where contrast-enhanced MRI is referenced to delineate lesions on NCCT, we propose ViPSAM, a visual prompting framework that leverages complementary cross-modality information. Built upon the Segment Anything Model (SAM), ViPSAM introduces a visual prompt encoder to extract guidance features from contrast-enhanced images and a visual-guided cross-attention module to integrate non-contrast and contrast-enhanced features, thereby enhancing lesion-relevant representations in low-contrast regions. The mask decoder is further adapted in a parameter-efficient manner to utilize visual prompts effectively. We evaluate the proposed method on liver lesion segmentation using NCCT acquired for proton therapy. Experimental results demonstrate that ViPSAM outperforms representative U-Net- and SAM-based methods, indicating that cross-modality visual prompting enables more robust and accurate segmentation in non-contrast images.
2607.14328.paper_summary_zh: 在質子治療計劃中，呼吸門控的無對比CT（NCCT）通常用於病變分割；然而，由於病變與背景的對比度低，準確的描繪仍然具有挑戰性。儘管基於學習的方法表現強勁，但它們在無對比圖像分割上常常面臨困難。受到臨床實踐的啟發，對比增強MRI被用來在NCCT上描繪病變，我們提出了ViPSAM，一種利用互補跨模態信息的視覺提示框架。ViPSAM建立在Segment Anything Model（SAM）之上，引入了一個視覺提示編碼器來從對比增強圖像中提取指導特徵，以及一個視覺引導的跨注意力模塊來整合無對比和對比增強特徵，從而增強低對比區域的病變相關表示。掩碼解碼器進一步以參數高效的方式進行調整，以有效利用視覺提示。我們在使用為質子治療獲取的NCCT進行肝病變分割的實驗中評估了所提出的方法。實驗結果表明，ViPSAM超越了代表性的U-Net和基於SAM的方法，這表明跨模態視覺提示使得在無對比圖像中實現更穩健和準確的分割成為可能。
